definitions.explanation: A scene of intense, violent conflict or fighting. Used metaphorically for any situation of extreme turmoil or ferocious competition.

definitions.gloss: Asura; warlike demigod in Buddhist cosmology
definitions.explanation: One of the six realms of Buddhist rebirth. Asuras are powerful beings consumed by jealousy and rage, perpetually at war.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦場|せんじょう}→戦場：12746_senjou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{修羅|しゅら}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{化|か}した→化す：29802_kasu⟧。
examples.english: The battlefield turned into a scene of carnage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修羅場|しゅらば}→修羅場：10599_shuraba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くぐり{抜|ぬ}けてきた⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: People who have been through hellish ordeals are strong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{修羅|しゅら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧になった。
examples.english: The election campaign became a brutal battle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仏教|ぶっきょう}→仏教：11428_bukkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{修羅|しゅら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絶|た}えない→絶える：13814_taeru⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In Buddhism, the realm of the Asuras is said to be a world of endless conflict.

examples.japanese: {六道|ろくどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{修羅道|しゅらどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
The compound ⟦{修羅場|しゅらば}→修羅場：10599_shuraba⟧ (literally "Asura battlefield") is extremely common in everyday Japanese, meaning a hellish scene, a dramatic confrontation, or a relationship crisis (e.g., being caught cheating). In casual speech ⟦{修羅場|しゅらば}→修羅場：10599_shuraba⟧ is often shortened to シュラバ.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{修羅場|しゅらば}→修羅場：10599_shuraba⟧ (hellish scene; dramatic confrontation)
- {修羅道|しゅらどう} (Asura realm in Buddhism)
- ⟦{阿修羅|あしゅら}→阿修羅：26334_ashura⟧ (Asura — the full Sanskrit-derived form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {修羅|しゅら}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{化|か}す→化す：29802_kasu⟧ (to turn into carnage)
- {修羅|しゅら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{如|ごと}く (like a scene of carnage)
- ⟦{修羅場|しゅらば}→修羅場：10599_shuraba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くぐる (to go through a hellish ordeal)
